run_vr_hand_simulation: run the pybullet VR hand simulation script that loads an MJCF hand model and connects to a VR glove via serial
create_convert_sensor_function: create a function that normalizes raw sensor values from 400-600 to a 0-1 float range with clamping
load_mjcf_hand_model: load a MuJoCo MJCF hand model XML file into the pybullet simulation using loadMJCF
create_hand_constraint: create a fixed joint constraint to position the simulated hand in the pybullet world
control_hand_joints: control individual hand joints using setJointMotorControl2 with position control and sensor-derived target values
